Damage, healing, resistances, status effects and interruption

Apply combat math and status rules once, through GAS-backed authoritative execution. Healing, damage types, criticals, buffs/debuffs, crowd control and cast interruption are authored rules, not hardcoded UI labels or sprite animation side effects.

Scope and player interaction

Apply combat math and status rules once, through GAS-backed authoritative execution. Healing, damage types, criticals, buffs/debuffs, crowd control and cast interruption are authored rules, not hardcoded UI labels or sprite animation side effects.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase07committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unaffected → Buffed → Debuffed → Casting → Interrupted → Controlled → Immune → Dead

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGEffectRules. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_CombatRules_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
DamageType: Physical|Fire|Frost|Storm|Spirit; authored extensible tags
RawAmount=max(0, BaseAmount + Power*Coefficient); reject nonfinite inputs
ArmorReduction=Armor/(Armor+100+10*AttackerLevel), clamp 0..0.75 for fixture
ElementalResistance: clamp -0.25..0.75; outgoing/incoming modifiers apply in documented order
CriticalChance: clamp 0..1; CriticalMultiplier>=1; server roll
EffectStackPolicy: Refresh|AddStackToCap|Independent|RejectDuplicate
InterruptPolicy: movement/damage/hard-control tags per ability; effect expiry uses server time

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGEffectRulesImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
CalculateEffectAmount(ValidatedContext) -> FiniteAmount|InvalidDefinition; pure server rules
ApplyAuthorizedEffect(TargetASC, EffectDefinition, Context) -> Applied|Immune|TargetDead
TryInterrupt(ActionSequence, ReasonTag) -> Interrupted|NotInterruptible|Stale
ExpireStatus(EffectHandle) -> Removed|AlreadyRemoved; GAS lifecycle

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Read accepted attacker stats and target mitigation under the definition's snapshot/dynamic policy; never calculate different authoritative formulas in UI, Character and ability.
  2. Compute raw amount, outgoing modifiers, mitigation/resistance, critical outcome and incoming modifiers in the documented order, then clamp finite bounds and health resources.
  3. Server applies the resulting GAS effect; death is detected once by the health/defeat owner rather than each damage source.
  4. Healing validates friendly policy and caps at missing health; overheal may be recorded but is not extra XP or threat unless explicitly authored.
  5. Status application evaluates immunity, stacking, duration, periodic tick ownership and interruption. A canceled channel stops future ticks but does not undo already committed impacts.
  6. Replicate effect tags/resource outcomes and semantic cues; UI shows duration from server time and clears stale icons on avatar replacement.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author GE_Damage, GE_Healing and representative burn/slow/stun effects with definitions/tags. Keep periodic damage on the authority and use stable effect context for credit.
  2. Set training dummy armor to 20, attacker level to 1 and raw physical amount to 20: expected pre-round damage is 20*(1-20/130), approximately 16.923; record the chosen rounding policy.
  3. Create an interruptible Arcanist cast and a Warden heal targeting Ally_A. Configure cancel tags and remove skeletal montage prerequisites.
  4. Bind WBP_HUD resource bars/status rows to ASC delegates. Tooltips explain damage type and resistance without independently recomputing hidden server rolls.
  5. Reopen death, threat and combat-log consumers: damage accepted emits one verified event; no UI event can grant kill credit.

Reopen Phase07 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / ArmoredDummy / Ally_A / StatusProbe. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
NaN/negative/unbounded input -> InvalidDefinition/Payload, no attribute corruption.
Heal dead target without resurrection ability -> TargetDead.
Apply same nonstacking effect twice -> refresh/reject per policy, not accidental double periodic ticks.
Interrupt stale action sequence -> Stale; current new cast continues.
Disconnect/zone travel -> short transient effects canceled; long expiry effects restored only under explicit durable policy.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

No PvP crowd-control diminishing returns initially. For repeated PvE stun, propose boss immunity tags and a per-target recent-control budget only when encounter tests justify it. Critical and mitigation values are balance proposals.

Combat log includes damage type, amount, mitigation, critical flag and source execution ID, not raw hidden RNG seeds. Provide text/icons for effects and a reduced-motion option.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
